Document Summary: 
ZBrain by LeewayHertz presents a versatile AI deployment strategy for higher education institutions seeking to integrate advanced language models without being restricted to proprietary solutions, with full control over their model choices and data governance as they host on-premises or in managed cloud environments. The platform leverages open-source options like Llama 3.2 & Qwen2.5 for non-English tasks at cost efficiency alongside GPT variants such as Claude Sonnet, facilitating complex advising roles and ensuring compliance with stringent regulations through specialized services like Voyage AI's RAG embeddings and Deepgram’s speech processing capabilities to cater to a spectrum of language-related challenges in academia.

rag_sources.text:
ZBrain AI Strategy & Model Usage
ZBrain does not own proprietary models. Instead, it provides a deployment-agnostic orchestration
platform enabling institutions to configure their optimal model mix while maintaining complete data
sovereignty.
Provider & Model Breakdown
Self-Hosted Open Source (70% Default - Institutional Infrastructure)
• Llama 3.2 405B (general reasoning, multilingual)
• Qwen2.5 72B (cost-effective, non-English excellence)
• Mistral Large 2 (EU GDPR compliance, performance/cost)
• CodeLlama 70B (technical advising, programming tutors)
• Mixtral 8x22B (European data residency)
Deployment: Kubernetes clusters in institutional VPCs
Commercial APIs (30% Complex Tasks - Enterprise Contracts)
**OpenAI**
• GPT-5.2, GPT-5.1 (advanced reasoning, document analysis)
• GPT-4.1 (high-complexity academic advising)
Use Case: Essay evaluation, nuanced policy interpretation
**Anthropic**
• Claude Sonnet 4.5, Haiku 4.5 (safety-critical compliance)
Use Case: Financial aid rules, degree audit exceptions
**Google**
• Gemini 3.0 Flash (real-time voice/chat, search augmentation)
Use Case: 24/7 student engagement, live Q&A
Specialized Services
**Voyage AI**: RAG embeddings (course catalogs, policies)
**Deepgram**: Real-time speech-to-text (international accents)

**PGVector**: Institutional knowledge base (Banner/ERP sync)
Security & Compliance Architecture
Institutional Deployment Options
1. Private Cloud VPC (AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, GCP)
2. On-premises air-gapped deployment
3. LeewayHertz managed SOC2 Type II environment
4. Hybrid (self-hosted core + commercial APIs)
Compliance Certifications
✓ ISO 27001:2022 ✓ SOC 2 Type II ✓ GDPR ✓ HIPAA ✓ FERPA-ready
✓ End-to-end AES-256 encryption ✓ Zero vendor data retention
✓ Granular RBAC ✓ Audit trails ✓ Network isolation
Higher Education Specific Controls
Academic RAG Pipeline
• Banner/SIS integration (field-level encryption)
• Course catalogs → automatic chunking/embedding
• Policy documents → mandatory citation enforcement
• Student records → consent-based access only
Task-Specific Model Routing (Exactly Your Strategy)
General student queries → Qwen2/Llama 3.2 (70%)
Essay feedback → Claude Sonnet 4.5/GPT-5.1 (20%)
Complex advising → GPT-5.2 (10%)
Code/debugging → CodeLlama 70B
Deployment Philosophy
"We enable institutions to own their AI stack completely:
• Full source code access
• Model weights downloaded locally
• No per-token pricing surprises
• Swap providers without re-architecture
